adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 4 shows PROCYON input interfaces for two listed inference routes: panel a depicts a multimodal prompt with miglitol mechanism text plus drug structure for ranking protein domains, and panel d depicts indication-description text plus bupropion name/structure for indication-specific drug-target retrieval.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop from Figure 3a is invalid because it shows a disease-association QA task not present in the listed routes. A better visible source exists in Figure 4 of the paper (candidate figure 5). Its panels a and d explicitly show the route-specific model inputs named in the record: drug mechanism text with miglitol structure, and indication-description text with bupropion structure. Under the atlas rules, a model box is not required when the prompt/interface clearly depicts the actual supplied input object, and these panels do so directly. Using the full figure is defensible because it visibly contains both valid input panels from the same source figure.
